description: This file defines the abstract class EntityConditionValue, which serves as a base for representing condition expression values in the OFBiz framework's entity component. It includes nested classes and methods related to SQL construction and value handling within entity conditions.

classes.name: EntityConditionValue
classes.description: Abstract base class for condition expression values, providing methods for SQL generation, value retrieval, and model field association.

classes.name: EntityConditionValue.ConstantNumberValue
classes.description: Concrete subclass representing a constant numeric value within a condition.

methods.name: constantNumber
methods.description: Static factory method to create a ConstantNumberValue instance.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Appends the SQL representation of the value to a StringBuilder, considering table aliases and model entity context.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns an immutable version of the condition value; in this implementation, it returns itself.

methods.name: getModelField
methods.description: Retrieves the model field associated with the condition value.

methods.name: setModelField
methods.description: Associates a model field with the condition value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the actual value from an entity or via delegator and a map.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Validates the SQL representation against the model entity.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates the SQL string representation of the condition value.
